require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Public checkout time choice", type: :system do
  include ActiveSupport::Testing::TimeHelpers

  around do |example|
    travel_to Time.zone.local(2026, 6, 21, 12, 0, 0)
    example.run
  ensure
    travel_back
  end

  before do
    clear_public_ordering_records
    create(:opening_hour, day_of_week: Time.zone.today.wday, opens_at: "00:00", closes_at: "23:59")
    @lost = create(:pickup_slot, starts_at: Time.zone.local(2026, 6, 21, 15, 20), capacity: 4)
    @later = create(:pickup_slot, starts_at: Time.zone.local(2026, 6, 21, 15, 40), capacity: 4)
    seed_site_settings
    seed_menu
  end

  it "loads the hour list on open, then substitutes a full hour before asking for a phone" do
    visit root_path
    record_availability_requests

    find(".checkout-slot-picker > summary").click
    expect(page).to have_css(".checkout-slot-picker[open]")
    expect(page).to have_css("[data-cart-target='slotGrid'] button", text: "15:20")
    page.document.synchronize(5) do
      raise Capybara::ElementNotFound unless availability_bodies.any? { |body| body.include?('"catalog":true') }
    end

    @lost.update!(reserved_count: @lost.capacity)
    find("[data-cart-target='slotGrid'] button", text: "15:20", visible: :all).click

    expect(page).to have_css("dialog.hour-modal[open]", text: "15:40")
    expect(page).to have_css("[data-cart-target='slotGrid'] [aria-pressed='true']", text: "15:40", visible: :all)
    expect(page).to have_css("[data-cart-target='checkoutPhoneProofPanel'][hidden]", visible: :all)

    bodies = refresh_without_catalog
    expect(bodies.count { |body| body.include?('"catalog":true') }).to eq(1)
    expect(bodies.last).to include('"catalog":false')
  end

  it "keeps tomorrow's nearest hour selected when it was not on the drawn day" do
    tomorrow = Time.zone.local(2026, 6, 22, 15, 20)
    create(:opening_hour, day_of_week: tomorrow.wday, opens_at: "00:00", closes_at: "23:59")
    @later.update!(starts_at: tomorrow)

    visit root_path
    record_availability_requests
    find(".checkout-slot-picker > summary").click
    expect(page).to have_css(".checkout-slot-picker[open]")
    page.document.synchronize(5) do
      raise Capybara::ElementNotFound unless availability_bodies.any? { |body| body.include?('"catalog":true') }
    end

    @lost.update!(reserved_count: @lost.capacity)
    find("[data-cart-target='slotGrid'] button", text: "15:20").click

    later_token = @later.signed_id(purpose: :public_checkout)
    expect(page).to have_css("dialog.hour-modal[open]", text: "jutro, 15:20")
    expect(page).to have_css("[data-cart-target='pickupSlotLabel']", text: "jutro, 15:20")
    expect(stored_pickup_token).to eq(later_token)
    page.document.synchronize(5) do
      pressed = page.evaluate_script(<<~JS)
        document.querySelector("[data-cart-target='slotGrid'] [aria-pressed='true']")?.dataset?.cartSlotTokenParam
      JS
      raise Capybara::ElementNotFound unless pressed == later_token
    end
    expect(page).to have_css(".pickup-day__label", text: "Jutro")
    catalog_for_later = availability_bodies.any? do |body|
      body.include?('"catalog":true') && body.include?(later_token)
    end
    expect(catalog_for_later).to be(true)
  end

  def stored_pickup_token
    page.evaluate_script(<<~JS)
      JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem("smashnego:selected-pickup-slot:v1:default") || "null")?.token
    JS
  end

  def record_availability_requests
    execute_script(<<~JS)
      window.__availabilityBodies = []
      const original = window.fetch
      window.fetch = async function(url, options = {}) {
        const response = await original.call(this, url, options)
        if (String(url).includes("availability")) window.__availabilityBodies.push(String(options.body || ""))
        return response
      }
    JS
  end

  def availability_bodies
    page.evaluate_script("window.__availabilityBodies")
  end

  def refresh_without_catalog
    page.evaluate_async_script(<<~JS)
      const done = arguments[0]
      const runtime = document.querySelector("[data-controller~='cart']").__cartRuntime
      runtime.cartAvailability.refresh().then(() => done(window.__availabilityBodies))
    JS
  end

  def seed_site_settings
    create(:site_setting, key: "hero", content: { "first_slot" => "15:20" })
    create(:site_setting, key: "loyalty", content: {})
    create(:site_setting, key: "location", content: {})
    create(:site_setting, key: "contact", content: {})
    create(:site_setting, key: "reviews", content: {})
    create(:site_setting, key: "faq", content: { "items" => [] })
  end

  def seed_menu
    burgers = create(:menu_category, name: "Burgery", slug: "burgery", sort_order: 1)
    classic = create(:menu_item, menu_category: burgers, name: "Classic", family: "Classic")
    create(:menu_variant, menu_item: classic, name: "Single", price_cents: 2_500)
    [ burgers, classic ].each { |target| create(:availability_override, target:, status: "available") }
  end
end
